notes: Ordinary shares priced from the primary listing on Euronext Brussels (ABI.BR) in EUR rather than the NYSE ADS (BUD, one ADS = one ordinary share). The newest stated count is the statement of capital at June 30, 2026 in the half-year interim financial report; the nine-month interim report (6-K of October 29, 2026) gives only a weighted average (1,973 million), so it is not used, and buybacks under the USD 6 billion programme continued after June 30. Ordinary shares outstanding = 2,019,241,973 total − 222,037,958 restricted − 47,676,768 treasury = 1,749,527,247 (the report states no ordinary-ex-treasury figure; treasury shares are taken as ordinary shares, as the restricted shares are held by Altria and BEVCO). Treasury shares fell from 68,489,754 at December 31, 2025 to 47,676,768 at June 30, 2026 with the total share count unchanged; the 20-F cover's 1,797,199,994 ordinary shares at December 31, 2025 include treasury shares. Restricted shares are priced through ABI.BR.
